message: a bare `I(...)` probe of a branch that receives no contribution anywhere is only supported when one terminal is the module's implicit ground reference
description: Probing the current of a branch that nothing contributes to means adding a zero-volt source for it, which this code generator does only for a branch to ground.
actions: Contribute `V(a, b) <+ 0;` to the branch, which makes its current an unknown that can be read.
